seo.title: About ABLEHARBOR | Your Offshore Operations Partner
seo.description: Learn about ABLEHARBOR, a remote data entry and virtual assistant support company based in Sylhet, Bangladesh.

sections.heading: A dedicated team. Operations made easier.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR is a remote-first operations support company based in Sylhet, Bangladesh. We provide people, build dedicated teams and coordinate day-to-day delivery for clients who need dependable support with recurring data-entry and administrative tasks.

sections.heading: Built by People. Driven by Purpose.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR is built by a team committed to dependable remote operations support.

sections.heading: How our operating model works
sections.body: Each assignment follows the client's instructions, systems and agreed workflow. A dedicated agent or team handles the work, while an ABLEHARBOR supervisor monitors coordination, progress and quality. Your business remains in control of its processes.

seo.title: Remote Data Entry Services | ABLEHARBOR
seo.description: Structured data entry, PDF and image to spreadsheet conversion, product information entry and quality checks.

sections.heading: Reliable data entry, organized around your workflow.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR provides remote data entry support for businesses that need information captured, organized, updated or transferred into structured formats. Our agents follow your templates, source materials, instructions and agreed quality requirements.

sections.heading: Data entry tasks we can discuss

items.title: Spreadsheet data entry
items.body: Enter, organize, update and format information in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets using your field structure and templates.

items.title: PDF, image and document to spreadsheet
items.body: Transfer readable information from supplied PDFs, scanned documents, photographs, menus and other source files into structured spreadsheets.

items.title: Product information and description entry
items.body: Prepare product names, model details, materials, features, measurements, patterns, categories and descriptions using client-provided references and guidelines.

items.title: Data review and quality checks
items.body: Review entries for completeness, formatting consistency and alignment with source information or client checklists.

seo.title: Virtual Assistant Services | ABLEHARBOR
seo.description: Flexible task-based virtual assistant support for administration, inbox tasks, research and routine business operations.

sections.heading: Practical virtual assistant support for everyday business tasks.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR provides task-based remote assistance for businesses that need help with routine administrative and operational activities. You define the tasks, tools, priorities and procedures; the assigned agent follows the agreed workflow.

sections.heading: Virtual assistant tasks we can discuss

items.title: Administrative assistance
items.body: Organizing information, maintaining records, preparing documents and following established procedures.

items.title: Email and inbox support
items.body: Organizing inboxes, sorting messages, preparing draft responses or flagging items according to client-defined rules.

items.title: Internet research and data collection
items.body: Gathering information from specified sources and preparing structured summaries or spreadsheets.

items.title: Document and file management
items.body: Organizing digital documents, updating records and maintaining agreed naming conventions.

seo.title: NDA & Confidentiality | ABLEHARBOR
seo.description: Learn about ABLEHARBOR's approach to client confidentiality, agreed access and non-disclosure arrangements.

sections.heading: Your business information deserves careful handling.
sections.body: ABLEHARBOR understands that data entry and virtual assistant work may involve access to internal business information. We are prepared to review and sign a mutually agreed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before confidential project information is shared or access is granted, subject to authorized approval.

items.title: Mutually agreed NDA
items.body: The document, parties, permitted purpose, duration, exclusions and other terms are reviewed and agreed before signature.

items.title: Access based on project responsibilities
items.body: The client and ABLEHARBOR discuss which personnel need access, which systems or files are involved and what actions are permitted.

items.title: Client instructions for information handling
items.body: File-sharing methods, storage locations, communication channels, retention periods and deletion requirements are agreed during onboarding.

items.title: No public use without permission
items.body: Client-provided confidential material and business records are not intentionally used in public marketing without prior permission.
